messages:
ella_sales: FYI - AuroraBank wants Private Deploy POC. Requirements: no internet egress except 3 hostnames, preserve client source IP to their app logs, KMS BYOK for keys, and an estimate for POC vs reserved pricing. Can we draft a short network playbook and firewall snippets to share?

devon_netops: Two options: VPC peering (preserves srcIP if no NAT) or PrivateLink (isolated but SNATs -> srcIP lost). If srcIP required, recommend peering with route table entries and no NAT.

maya_solutions: If peering impossible, suggest a customer-side proxy that appends X-Forwarded-For (requires app change) or deploy a tiny sidecar that preserves original IP in headers.

kevin_security: KMS: we support BYOK via AWS KMS cross-account grants. Enterprise customers can request HSM-backed CMKs. Keys remain customer-managed; rotation is handled by their KMS policy. I'll draft the questionnaire text.

devon_netops: Quick SG example to share:
Type: HTTPS  Protocol: TCP  Port Range: 443  Destination: 203.0.113.20/32, 203.0.113.21/32
Type: DNS    Protocol: UDP  Port Range: 53   Destination: 198.51.100.10/32
If they need hostname allowlist, advise outbound HTTPS proxy; we can provide stable proxy IPs for POC. iptables pattern to force proxy:
iptables -t nat -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.10.10.5:3128
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 203.0.113.20 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j DROP

opsbot: Ticket SALES-4999 created for AuroraBank POC playbook. Owner: devon_netops. Due: 48h.

ella_sales: Thanks all 1 I'll send the playbook to aurorabank-net once we have the doc.
